b.x: This does not defend government, church, media, or the market. It also does not found a sect. It does not teach crime, hatred of a people, or flight from the law. In Brazil, if the violence is now, 190. This page does not dial.

If you need someone to authorize you to think, leave. If you want a ready sentence to repeat in the group, leave. Sleep is a right. This tab is not for whoever still wants sleep. In the film The Matrix, Morpheus offers two pills. The blue one: the story ends, you wake in bed and believe whatever you want to believe. The red one: you stay in Wonderland and he shows you how deep the rabbit hole goes. The line in the film is direct. This is your last chance. After this, there is no turning back. Here the rule is the same. Whoever is not ready closes the page. Whoever stays, stays to see the mechanism. Not to gain a new master.

In the film, the Matrix is a simulated world so complete that whoever is inside takes it for reality. The body is in a pod. The mind lives the life the system drew. The film says: the Matrix is the world that has been pulled over your eyes to blind you from the truth. And it says more: you are a slave, like everyone else, born into a prison you cannot see, smell, or touch. A prison for the mind. In our reality there is no cable to pull. The Matrix is the set of stories that lead you before you notice. Who you must be in order to be accepted. What you must fear this week. Who is licensed to say what is true. What you must buy, vote, confess, or repeat so the machine stays fed. You are not in a computer dream. You are in an agreement. The agreement says: repeat the sentence and the group leaves you in peace. Ask, and the group punishes you. Most people call that agreement normality. Normality is the polite name of the pod.

The media does not sell truth. It sells attention. Fear and anger hold the eye longer than a fact. What holds the eye is repeated until it looks like the world. The government does not love you. It administers. It needs obedience, tax, and a story in which its violence is order and yours is crime. Some laws protect the weak. Others protect the chair. The gray man reads who the law was written for and still obeys the law. This page does not teach you to run from the police. Religion, when it is conscience, can make a person honest. When it is a machine, it rents out God. It sells fear of hell, of the apocalypse, and of being cast out, and it calls the question a sin. A pastor who cannot be questioned is not a pastor. He is an operator. The same gesture exists in the guru, the coach, and the leader of the movement. The clothes change. The rent is the same. The market sells you an identity in installments. The job sells your hours. The screen sells your face back to you. None of them need you awake. They need you predictable. School, when it works, teaches you to read. When it works for the machine, it teaches you to wait for the bell and to call the approved sentence knowledge. None of this is a villain in a cape. It is incentive. Where there is an incentive for you not to ask, there is the pod.

The red pill is not a party and it is not a new church. It is the refusal to lend out your eyes. Before you believe the sentence, look at the incentive. Who gains if I am afraid? Who gains if I hate the neighbor? Who gains if I never ask? If the answer is a pulpit, a newsroom, a chair, or a cash register, the sentence is not truth. It is feed. The film says: welcome to the desert of the real. The desert is not a pretty set. It is the world without the narration that numbs you. The film also says: there is no spoon. The spoon bends because the limit was in the mind that accepted the room. The limit of this room is the sentence you are ashamed to examine. Free your mind is not memorizing a slogan. It is being able to last one minute without the group. Morpheus tells Neo: I can only show you the door. You are the one who has to walk through it. Nobody walks through it for you. Not this site.
The gray man already took half

The gray man has already left half the pod. He stopped playing the role they asked for. He does not show off. He does not become a stage. He does not ask for applause for being awake. The other half of the pill is this: do not become the priest of awakening. Whoever shouts that he left the Matrix is still on stage. The desert of the real is quiet. You see the mechanism and you do not become its new priest. You stay inside the law. You stay at the table, if the table is yours. You stay able to call 192 when the body fails and 190 when the violence is now. Seeing the truth does not cancel the duty to whoever is beside you. It cancels only blind obedience. The hour of waking is not a date. It is the minute you stop asking the machine for permission to see.
